title: Integrative network pharmacology and molecular simulation analysis reveals the therapeutic potential of Coscinium fenestratum alkaloids against SARS-CoV-2.
authors: Sakthi, P; Arun, K; Priya, D
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子模拟研究植物碱对SARS-CoV-2宿主蛋白（如STAT3）的抑制作用，对象为病毒-宿主蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上分子对接/MD可部分借鉴，故评分低。
abstract: SARS-CoV-2 variants resist all direct antivirals across clades, necessitating immediate therapeutic interventions that use conserved inflammatory mechanisms not utilized in existing pharmacotherapy. Even though Coscinium fenestratum is known to contain alkaloids like berberine, palmatine, and tembetarine, and traditional medicine says it can change the immune system, no systematic computational analysis has looked at its multi-target potential against SARS-CoV-2 host dependency factors that are important for viral replication and immunopathology. This study integrates network pharmacology, identifying 335 shared targets between C. fenestratum alkaloids and SARS-CoV-2 host proteins; molecular docking across five hub targets; SiteMap analysis confirming a druggable STAT3 binding cavity (D-score = 1.01); 100 ns MD simulations demonstrating complex stability (RMSD < 3 A, RMSF <1.2 A); and MM/GBSA refinement positioning the tembetarine-STAT3 interaction as the lead candidate (binding free energy DeltaG_bind = -41.47 kcal/mol). STAT3/AKT1 are the most important hubs (centrality 140, 172) that cause the dysregulation of PI3K-Akt and JAK-STAT, which is a key part of the variant-independent COVID-19 cytokine storm pathophysiology. Tembetarine has enhanced binding affinity and pharmacokinetic viability, placing C. fenestratum alkaloids for prompt experimental validation via variant-circumventing, multi-target host modulation urgently required in the global SARS-CoV-2 treatment pipeline.
abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2变体抵抗所有进化支中的直接抗病毒药物，因此迫切需要利用现有药物治疗中未采用的保守炎症机制进行即时治疗干预。尽管已知Coscinium fenestratum含有小檗碱（berberine）、掌叶防己碱（palmatine）和坦贝他林（tembetarine）等生物碱，且传统医学认为其能调节免疫系统，但尚无系统性计算分析研究其对SARS-CoV-2宿主依赖因子（对病毒复制和免疫病理学至关重要）的多靶点潜力。本研究整合了网络药理学，识别出C. fenestratum生物碱与SARS-CoV-2宿主蛋白之间的335个共享靶点；对五个核心靶点进行分子对接；SiteMap分析确认了一个可成药STAT3结合腔（D-score = 1.01）；100 ns分子动力学模拟展示复合物稳定性（RMSD < 3 Å，RMSF <1.2 Å）；以及MM/GBSA精化将坦贝他林-STAT3相互作用定位为首选候选（结合自由能DeltaG_bind = -41.47 kcal/mol）。STAT3/AKT1是最重要的核心枢纽（中心性140, 172），导致PI3K-Akt和JAK-STAT通路失调，这是变体非依赖性COVID-19细胞因子风暴病理生理学的关键部分。坦贝他林具有增强的结合亲和力和药代动力学可行性，使C. fenestratum生物碱能够通过规避变体、多靶点宿主调节进行快速实验验证，这在全球SARS-CoV-2治疗管线中亟需。
